education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the

SPECIFICATION FOR 

COUNTERSINKS, PILOT TYPE, FOR 

ORTHOPAEDIC USE 



o 

0) 

a. 
o 



1- Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for Pilot type countersinks intented for preparing 
a drilled pilot hole in bone to receive the tapered head of medical bone screw. 



2. Shape and Dimensions— As shown in Fig. 1. 



[—SHANK DIA, ( 

OPTIONAL ,±(K0 



BODY DIA,OPTIONAL,±0'40 



■SHANK 





1 D DIA PILOT 

— 4-8 max, 



OVERALL LENGTH, OPTIONAL, ±1'6 



Screw Size D Max 

M6 2-80 

M7 3'05 

M8 3'45 

Note 1 — Number of flutes optional. 

Note 2 — Flute configuration optional. 

N*te 3— Pilot point configuration optional except as specified. 

All dimensions in millimetres. 

FIG. 1 COUNTERSINK, PILOT TYPE, FOR ORTHOPAEDIC USE 

2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions, except where specified. 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30CM3 or 40Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel bars, and flats \ 

4- Heat Treatment — The countersink shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 550 
to 600 HV. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The point of the countersinks shall be concentric with the shank. 

5.2 It shall be free from burrs, cracks and draw marks. 

5.3 It shall be sharpened and well finished.

IS: 8608 -1977 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance Test— Fit the countersink in a suitable chuck. Make ten countersinks in series, in 
a fresh sheep bone of at least 10 mm thickness, without interruptions. The countersink shall do it 
without seizing or chokirrg or damaging the point. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the countersinks in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 * Method for 
boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. The 
countersinks shall show no sign of corrosion after the test, 

7. Marking — The countersinks shall be marked at the shank portion with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISl Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



Printed at Neelkamal Printers, Delhi, India
